subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this grouped set of privileged GitHub Action revisions after the four guard assertions are repaired?
rationale: Automation can prove repository consistency and release-tag provenance, but accepting new third-party executable code at token, publishing, security-result, maintenance, and agent-credential boundaries requires owner intent.

options.title: Audit and accept batch
options.body: Review the privileged revisions together, repair the guards, and merge after refreshed exact-head checks.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate token, publishing, CodeQL/SARIF, maintenance, and Codex Action updates into smaller independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Hold current pins
options.body: Retain the existing revisions until owners are ready to complete the grouped supply-chain audit.

recommendation.title: Audit and accept batch
recommendation.body: Review the privileged revisions together, repair the guards, and merge after refreshed exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current guard assertions and is the strongest individual routing candidate adjacent to the affected automation surface; the openclaw-secops team should review its owned security workflows.
